title: Resolver v3.0 Released
message: Resolver v3.0 is out thanks to bungles, our biggest update yet: Wildcards, Forge Couple, prompt history, LoRA variants & groups, Backup & Restore, a new dock and 40+ fixes. Huge thanks to Bungles for the v3.0 patch! It needs a new APK: install it over your current app and your images, history and settings stay as they are.
